assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached original eclipse helmet game asset. Regenerate this SAME helmet as a production-ready standalone game sprite. Eclipse: deep purple cosmic star-pattern shell, copper/rose-gold fittings and collar, violet-white curved glass reflections.
Preserve the original silhouette, three-quarter camera angle facing right, proportions, placement, decoration, material, color palette, soft polished illustrated 3D style, and exact square framing. Only slight geometry changes are acceptable to repair the glass.
REQUIRED REPAIR: one smooth unbroken convex visor pane covering the entire face window from top to the FRONT lower collar. Completely omit the INNER/REAR elliptical collar arc currently crossing the lower face window. There must be NO ellipse/ring/bar/seam/open crescent/slot/hole across the lower third of the glass. Keep only the outer FRONT/BOTTOM collar and the left side fitting, outside the face window. The glass flows seamlessly all the way down to that front collar.
Fill the ENTIRE pane with smooth subtly tinted visible glass paint, including the currently empty black/transparent center and the lower muzzle area. Preserve delicate curved reflections to read as glass, but do not create alpha holes inside the pane. The game applies transparency later. No head, face, animal, body, words, labels, extra objects, black patches, or checkerboard pixels.
Transparent background OUTSIDE the helmet only, including the empty space below the front collar. Keep the helmet in the same normalized position and scale as the reference, with no cropping, rotation or added padding. Return ONE square PNG sprite.
assets.background_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit ONLY the backdrop of the supplied helmet sprite. Preserve the helmet itself pixel-for-pixel in shape, scale, placement, colors, reflections and decoration. Replace all gray/white checkerboard OUTSIDE the helmet with ONE absolutely uniform pure chroma green RGB(0,255,0) (#00FF00) flat background. Also replace the checkerboard space below the helmet and any gap below the collar/above the strap, but preserve all helmet parts and the entire solid glass pane. NO green in the glass. NO checkerboard, gradient, drop shadow, tint contamination or new object. The helmet will be extracted using the game's existing exterior-only matte export. Square image, identical framing.

assets.chin_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached Rose helmet. REPAIR THE BROKEN OPEN CHIN. The long dangling purple strap and empty green gap under the helmet are a defect. Replace that entire open underside with a continuous CLOSED structural chin guard joined to the lower visor frame and the left/rear shell. It must be one solid enclosed helmet shell under the chin, with graceful ivory/cream lacquer surface, deep purple lower band, fine gold edging, and the existing pink rose/petal decoration. NO opening between the bottom of the face window and the chin, NO separate floating strap, NO green gap through the chin. Front chin guard smoothly meets lower visor edge. Keep the already continuous convex face glass free of any internal rear rim, holes, horizontal bar or seam over the face.
Preserve the original cream, vivid pink, purple and gold color palette, artwork style, three-quarter right-facing angle, scale, placement, and all unaffected decoration. Make the smallest tasteful shape correction needed to close the chin; do not inflate the head or add a person. Keep the backdrop uniform #00FF00 green OUTSIDE the fully enclosed helmet only. No checkerboard, words or extra objects. One square game sprite.

assets.prompt:

Regenerate this SAME standalone helmet, preserving its shape, colors, angle, normalized framing, proportions, decorations, material, and polished illustrated 3D style. Royal: dark deep teal convex glass, silver side fitting/front lower collar, ornate gold crown with exactly the original shape and jewels.
Repair ONLY the visor construction: one smooth continuous convex glass pane down to the FRONT lower collar. OMIT the INNER/REAR elliptical collar arc currently crossing the lower face window. No inner ellipse, bar, seam, slot, hole or open crescent over the muzzle. Keep the outer FRONT/BOTTOM collar and side shell fittings. Fill ALL of the face pane with continuous subtly tinted glass paint and curved reflections. NO alpha-empty areas inside the glass; game rendering will apply transparency later. Keep opaque decorations opaque. Slight geometry changes acceptable only to make a continuous closed visor.
No animal, head, face, body, words, labels or extra objects. ONE square image, same framing/scale/position as reference, no cropping or added padding. Place on a perfectly uniform pure chroma green background RGB(0,255,0), #00FF00, ONLY outside the complete helmet (also in the gap around the halo for Seraph). This outside backdrop is for the existing game's exterior matte export. No green reflections, no checkerboard, no shadow on backdrop. Preserve all helmet colors without green tint contamination.
